features.summary: Opens the project guide. It can preview a contract and detect an ArkGate config. It does not enable a project by itself.
features.test: guide on a new project detects ark.config.json and includes the import

features.summary: Prints whether this directory is enforced. Before pregate enable it says nothing is enforced. It does not turn enforcement on.
features.test: status and doctor lead with enforced, advisor and unverified rules on a mixed contract

features.summary: Applies a reviewed digest when the human gives the code. A bare approve with no terminal leaves the proposal. It is not how a project becomes enabled.
features.test: a detached approve with piped stdin names the root and command and leaves the proposal

features.summary: Records consent for this worktree. Hooks enforce a project only after this command. A directory that never ran it stays open.
Withdraws consent for this worktree, or the whole project with --project. Hooks stop enforcing here. Other enabled projects stay as they were.
Evaluates the contract for the project or for one file on stdin. A hook still blocks a tool only where pregate enable ran.
features.test: stdin check denies indirect eval and allows names that only contain those letters

features.summary: Reports findings for the repository under the live policy. It does not enable the project. A hook blocks work only where pregate enable ran.
features.test: a declaration file with an import type query audits clean

features.summary: Moves a reviewed rule to enforce through a preview and an approval. The ratchet keeps an existing finding. Promotion does not enable a project that never ran pregate enable.
features.test: promote moves dirty CA-DEP-001 to enforce; the ratchet keeps the old finding and denies a new one

features.summary: Reports whether adopted project assertions pass. With no contract it refuses. After enable, unbound requirements stay unverified and the lock is unchanged.
Writes the contract and, with --yes and unattended approval already set, activates consent. Ordinary rules stay in shadow. A second directory is not enabled by this one.
features.test: init recommends %s and approval preserves shadow debt inventory

features.summary: Recommends packs from the files it sees, including a JSON plan. It does not enable the project or select those packs.
features.test: scan --json recommends hono for an app and not for docs, examples, or fixtures

features.summary: Shows or previews a layer map. Applying it is a reviewed change. It does not enable enforcement in a directory that never ran pregate enable.
features.test: one terminal approval activates a new repo with layers and compiled project rules

features.summary: Previews an ArkGate config as a Pregate contract. The human approves before it applies. Import does not enable some other directory.
features.test: import preview, human approval, and a rule ArkGate owns is not reported twice

features.summary: Runs an isolated sample, or refuses an unknown language without creating one. The sample is not the caller's project. Refusing a language does not enable anything.
Prints session baselines and findings for the project. A clean check does not erase a Stop finding. The report does not enable a project.
features.test: compiled hooks and report retain the session baseline after committing a violation

features.summary: Previews a new session baseline, or refuses when this project has none. The lock stays unchanged. A directory with no contract is not rebased.
Drafts a local judgment of a finding. Applying it is a reviewed digest. Feedback does not enable a project that never ran pregate enable.
features.test: human feedback is local, digest-reviewed, reportable and deliberately replaceable

features.summary: Inspects local session storage and previews recovery of an abandoned lease. Apply is a reviewed command. It does not enable enforcement.
features.test: reviewed recovery removes a killed writer's lease without source or counter changes

features.summary: Drafts a fixture from a recorded denial, or says this repository has none. The active contract stays unchanged. A directory with no preset is not disputed.
Drafts an offline issue from a recorded event and submits only the approved body. It does not enable the project.
features.test: compiled issue reporting offers an offline review and sends only the approved body through gh

features.summary: Lists, shows, and enables a methodology through a review. The hook denies an agent pack enable after pregate enable. A project that was never enabled does not start enforcing that methodology.
Prints why a rule exists, or what a path is judged by. It does not change the contract and it does not enable a project.
features.test: Prisma 7 client breaks deny or warn through the hook and CLI, and Prisma 6 does not

features.summary: Shows, compiles, and applies the contract. Apply validates and asks before it writes. Compiling does not enable a second project.
features.test: D29: preset apply validates and prompts before changing the contract

features.summary: Runs a check's fixtures, or drafts a rule. Passing fixtures does not enable the project those fixtures describe.
features.test: pack fixtures pass through the compiled CLI

features.summary: Turns a rules document into a proposal or a template. Applying it is a preview the human approves. It does not enable a project by itself.
features.test: one terminal approval activates a new repo with layers and compiled project rules

features.summary: Writes the selected Git hook or CI backstop. Running it twice leaves the same settings. Install does not record pregate enable.
features.test: install run twice writes the same settings

features.summary: Reads GitHub Actions or Vercel status for a commit and can wait for it. It does not enable a project and it does not change the contract.
features.test: the compiled binary recognizes Vercel statuses and check runs, with and without Actions

features.summary: Installs the engine, launcher, and harness hooks on this machine. A project stays unenforced until pregate enable runs there.
features.test: D25: setup installs versioned skills; doctor detects missing/stale copies; uninstall removes them

features.summary: Installs a verified engine into the cache without registering harnesses or writing a launcher. It does not enable a project.
features.test: installs a verified engine into the cache without changing harness homes, skills, launcher, link or profiles

features.summary: Writes a project launcher or project hooks, and can set up the Claude hook in the repo. Those files do not enforce a checkout that never ran pregate enable.
features.test: setup is byte-idempotent, preserves foreign hooks, leaves HOME untouched, and denies only after policy consent

features.summary: Installs an engine and can prepare a project review without applying it. The old engine stays until that review is approved. Update does not enable a new directory.
features.test: the engine lands and warms up before the launcher names it; then that engine's setup runs; the old engine stays

features.summary: Removes the machine hooks, launcher, and engines after the same confirmation as disable. Projects are not enforced again until setup and enable.
features.test: --purge also removes the state; a link that is not ours stays

features.summary: Reads harness homes, hook files, and consent for this directory. In a home with no harness it says consent is inactive. It does not run pregate enable.
Prints the command list. The long help flag before initialization still lists pack categories. It does not enable a project.
features.test: the compiled library is discoverable and its fixtures run offline before initialization

features.summary: Prints the same command list as the long help flag. It does not enable a project or change the contract.
features.test: the compiled library is discoverable and its fixtures run offline before initialization

features.summary: Prints the engine version and the core version. It does not enable a project.
features.test: a fresh clone has no node_modules entry, no symlink outside the repo, and prints the package version

features.summary: The entry a harness hook executes. Inside an enabled project it can deny a tool. A directory that never ran pregate enable is allowed, including a hook bypass.
features.test: hook pre denies interpreter, script, Makefile and harness-settings bypasses

features.summary: Cursor Write on preToolUse. After enable, a control-text script and a preset replace are denied and the files stay put. The same kind of write is not blocked before enable.
Cursor Shell on preToolUse. After enable, a hook bypass and a node write are denied and not executed. That bypass is allowed before pregate enable.
